_readme: Real approved measurements imported from Juniper - Size Charts.xlsx (Crewnecks, T-Shirt, Hoodie, Jacket, Hat tabs). Values are in inches. Jacket width and Hat circumference are stored as {min,max} ranges (as approved) rather than single points, since that's how they're specified. Edit sizes/points directly here if measurements change - no code changes needed.
